description:
Below Zero is a cocktail bar in Berawa, Bali, where curiosity runs beneath the surface.

Built around vodka, tequila, and mezcal, our cocktail programme explores the distinct character of each spirit, with spices adding depth, aroma, and unexpected flavour. Every creation brings a playful idea to the glass, inviting you to discover something new.

Come for a cocktail, stay for the company, and see where the night takes you.
